title: The Bell Has a Pattern
short_role: Commit command attention before the first warning becomes a crisis.
setup: A road scout can mark the support lane now, but doing so consumes the command signal that might be needed during contact.

choices.label: Mark support lane (1 command)
choices.visible_result: The first Sapper contact will deal one less damage; one commander intervention is no longer available.

choices.label: Keep command ready
choices.visible_result: No command point is spent, but the support lane receives no advance mitigation.
